symptom: describe page left out a Data grid 2 column with no attribute and an empty header — the usual actions column, `column (Caption: '', ShowContentAs: customContent) { actionbutton … }` — and every widget in it; re-exec of the unchanged output said "Unchanged page", but the first real edit replaced the page and the column and its buttons were gone from the BSON, mx check 0 errors at both ends (mendixlabs/mxcli#1520).
cause: extractDataGrid2Columns took the first property holding Objects and kept a column only `if col.Attribute != "" || col.Caption != ""` — a heuristic to tell columns from other object lists that also threw away the one column shape with neither. Now the `columns` property is found by its resolved key and every object in it is a column; the heuristic stays only for an unresolved key, widened to content/content mode. outputDataGrid2ColumnV3 prints `Caption: ''` for a column with neither, which the writer stores as the empty template (applyColumnHeaderFallback).
insight: Write elision hides a describe drop: an unchanged re-exec is a no-op, so only an edited round trip shows the loss — the test must make a real edit and assert the edit landed (control) before asserting the column survived. `Caption: ''` with customContent is CE0463-free on both 11.6.6 and 11.15.0 (measured: mx check 0 errors), so ako/mxcli#1401 item 1 does not reproduce on current main.
